q: Under the Railway UPS Rules, 2026, the government contributes an estimated 8.5% of (basic pay + DA) to:

options.B: The NPS Tier-II account
options.D: A pool corpus used to provide assured pension benefits

q: Excluding the pool corpus, what is the total monthly credit to a UPS subscriber's individual account (employee + Railways)?

options.B: 18.5% of basic pay plus DA

q: Full assured pension under UPS — 50% of the average basic pay of the last 12 months before superannuation — is admissible after how many years of qualifying service?

options.B: 20 years

q: What is the minimum assured pension under UPS for a railway employee with 10 years of qualifying service?

options.B: Rs 12,000 per month

q: A railway employee retires under UPS with 16 years of qualifying service. What assured pension is he entitled to?

options.A: Full 50% of average basic pay of last 12 months
options.B: Assured pension on a proportionate basis (between the 10-year minimum and the 25-year full rate)
options.C: Only the minimum Rs 10,000 per month
options.D: No pension, as 25 years were not completed

q: The "full assured pension" under UPS is calculated as:

options.B: 60% of average emoluments of last 10 months
options.C: 50% of the average basic pay during the final 12 months before superannuation

q: Under the Railway UPS Rules, 2026, a subscriber may seek voluntary retirement after completing how many years of qualifying service?

options.B: 15 years

q: A railway employee in service as on 01.04.2025 and covered under NPS must exercise the option to join UPS in which form?

options.B: Form A2

q: Within what time must a serving railway employee (as on 01.04.2025) submit the UPS option in Form A2?

options.B: Within 30 days of the gazette notification

q: A railway employee covered under NPS superannuated on 31.03.2025. In which form does he exercise the UPS option?

options.B: Form A2

q: The legally wedded spouse of an NPS-covered railway employee who retired before 31.03.2025 and died before exercising the UPS option must apply in:

options.B: Form A2

q: A new recruit joins railway service on 20.06.2025 and is covered under NPS. By when must he exercise the UPS option?

options.B: Within 30 days of joining service, in Form A1

q: An eligible railway employee does not submit the UPS option within the prescribed target date. What is the consequence?

options.A: He is compulsorily enrolled in UPS
options.B: His salary is withheld until he opts
options.C: He gets an extended window of one more year
options.D: He is deemed to continue under NPS without the UPS option

q: After receiving the UPS notification, the Head of Office must notify the subscriber of his PRAN, enter it in the registration form and paste a certified copy in the service book within:

options.B: 20 days

q: The first UPS contribution must be credited to the subscriber's individual pension account within:

options.B: 20 days of submission of the application or by the end of the month in which the railway servant joined, whichever is earlier

q: If a railway servant's UPS enrolment is not completed by the date of drawal of salary for a month, what happens to his salary?

options.A: The salary for that month is cancelled
options.B: The salary is paid in the next month with interest
options.C: The salary is paid after withholding the contribution amount

q: Under the Railway UPS Rules, 2026, if the period spent under suspension is treated as duty (or as leave with leave salary) in the final orders, how are UPS contributions determined for that period?

options.A: No contributions are payable for the suspension period
options.B: Only the employee's share is adjusted
options.C: The pool corpus bears the full contribution
options.D: Contributions are determined on the emoluments the subscriber becomes entitled to, and the difference is credited to the individual corpus on the NAV of the last working day of the month

q: The Gazette of India notification carrying the Railway UPS Rules, 2026 was published on:
The Railway UPS Rules, 2026 apply to railway servants appointed:

options.A: On or after 01.01.2004 and covered under NPS
options.B: Before 01.01.2004 under the old pension scheme
options.D: Only on attaining 25 years of service

q: The government pool corpus under UPS exists primarily to:

options.A: Pay monthly salaries of railway staff
options.B: Fund withdrawals from NPS Tier-II accounts

q: The Railways' matching 10% contribution under UPS is calculated on:

options.B: Basic pay plus dearness allowance

q: Which of the following statements about UPS under the Railway UPS Rules, 2026 is TRUE?

options.A: The employee contributes 10% of basic pay plus DA every month to his individual UPS account
options.B: Full assured pension is payable after 10 years of service
options.D: UPS automatically replaces NPS for all railway employees
